skills.name: Bone stacking & base setup
skills.base: Lie on your back, legs vertical, hip–knee–ankle stacked, arms straight. Weight goes through bones, not muscle.
skills.flyer: Learn where your weight must land: directly over the base's stacked joints.
skills.yt_by: Acro Yoga Basics · How to Base

skills.name: Flyer body tension (hollow body)
skills.base: Give a stable platform; feedback when the flyer sags.
skills.flyer: Glutes squeezed, ribs in, one straight line ear–shoulder–hip–ankle. Drill: plank on floor, then plank on the base's hands.

skills.name: Spotting
skills.base: Agree on the exit before every new skill.
skills.flyer: Know the bail: tuck, land feet, never reach for the floor with straight arms.
skills.spotter: Stay at the flyer's hips, hands ready, never grab arms. Spot the shape, not the person.

skills.name: Hand grips (H2H, reverse, handshake)
skills.base: Hand-to-hand grip: fingers wrap the flyer's palm heel, wrists stacked. Reverse grip for back-facing shapes.
skills.flyer: Never death-grip — a light grip lets you feel balance.

skills.name: Calibration drills
skills.base: Bend knees to change height and feel where the flyer's weight sits; find the spot where holding costs nothing.
skills.flyer: Shift weight a few centimetres at a time until you 'float'. Talk: heavier / lighter / forward / back.

skills.name: Counterbalance (standing)
skills.base: Hold wrists, lean away, sit back into a chair together. Both are base.
skills.flyer: Trust the lean — the further both lean, the lighter it gets.

skills.name: Front Plank
skills.base: Feet on the flyer's hip bones, toes toward the hip crease. Hands clasped. Bend knees to receive, straighten to lift.
skills.flyer: Lean in with a straight body, gaze forward not down. Hands press down into the base's hands.
skills.note: The first pose everyone learns. Everything L-base builds on this.
skills.yt_by: Base + fly Front Plank and Bird

skills.name: Front Bird / Free Bird
skills.base: Same as Front Plank; let go once the flyer floats. Hands hover at the flyer's shoulders as backup.
skills.flyer: Release hands one at a time, arms sweep back like wings. Lift the chest, keep legs together.

skills.name: Bow
skills.base: Hold Free Bird; feet stay on the hip bones while the flyer changes shape.
skills.flyer: From Free Bird, bend knees and catch your own ankles; press feet into hands for a heart opener. Look forward.

skills.name: Throne
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's thighs close to the hips, toes out. Hands on the flyer's knees or hands.
skills.flyer: Sit tall on the base's feet as if in a chair. Enter from standing facing away (Foot-to-Shin entry) or from Bird.

skills.name: Straddle Throne
skills.base: Feet on the flyer's inner thighs near the hips, knees wide.
skills.flyer: Seated with legs wide, hands on the base's knees, then free. Basis of the throne-rotation machines.

skills.name: Foot to Shin (Mountain · Chair · Twisted Chair · Forward Fold)
skills.base: Legs vertical, flyer stands on your shins; hold hands for Mountain, release as balance comes.
skills.flyer: Step onto the shins, stand tall (Mountain), sit into Chair, twist, fold forward. Four shapes from one platform.

skills.name: Reverse Throne / Z-Throne
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's hamstrings with the flyer facing your feet.
skills.flyer: Sit facing away from the base's head; legs fold into a Z. Transition pose in throne rotations.

skills.name: Back Bird / Back Fly
skills.base: Feet on the flyer's upper back at the shoulder blades (high) or sacrum (low). Hands clasped, then release to the flyer's shoulders.
skills.flyer: Face up, arch over the feet, arms open. Keep legs long and together.

skills.name: Whale / High Flying Whale
skills.base: From Back Bird: feet along the upper back and shoulder blades, hands hold the flyer's shins or ankles and lift.
skills.flyer: Legs extend up over the base, chest opens. Lengthens the thoracic spine — one of the great therapeutic shapes.

skills.name: Reverse Bird
skills.base: Feet on the flyer's hip creases with the flyer facing your feet. Hands to the flyer's shoulders.
skills.flyer: Bird facing the other way — head over the base's feet, hands on the base's knees, then free.

skills.name: Back Plank
skills.base: Feet on the flyer's sacrum, hands connected hand-to-hand.
skills.flyer: Face up, whole body one straight line, hands pressing into the base's. Gateway to Trapdoor and Tumbleweed.

skills.name: Floating Paschimottanasana
skills.base: Feet on the flyer's hip creases; hands support the flyer's shins or thighs.
skills.flyer: Forward fold with legs extended forward over the base — a flying seated forward fold.

skills.name: Straddle Bat
skills.base: Feet on the flyer's hips (near the sacrum) as the flyer hangs inverted; hands on the flyer's shoulders to steer.
skills.flyer: Hang upside down, legs wide, hands on the base's shins then free. Usually entered from Folded Leaf.

skills.name: Bat
skills.base: As Straddle Bat.
skills.flyer: Straddle Bat with legs together or knees bent, hanging fully. Core for many machines.

skills.name: Boat
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's hips, hands connected.
skills.flyer: V-shape, legs and torso lifted, balancing on the base's feet.

skills.name: Mermaid
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's side hip and ribs; one hand supports the flyer's shoulder.
skills.flyer: Rest sideways across the base's feet, legs swept to one side, one hand on the base's shin.

skills.name: Koala
skills.base: Legs vertical and together; flyer wraps around them.
skills.flyer: Hug the base's legs like a koala on a tree — chest on the shins, hips on the feet. Basis of the Koala machines.

skills.name: Vishnu's Couch
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's side ribs and hip; one hand supports the flyer's elbow.
skills.flyer: Side-lying with head propped on hand, top leg extended — the reclining-god shape.

skills.name: Camel (in hands / low)
skills.base: Hands under the flyer's knees or feet under the shins depending on variation.
skills.flyer: Kneeling backbend held above the base.

skills.name: Backfly Dancer
skills.base: Back Bird feet; steady the flyer's shoulders during the leg change.
skills.flyer: Back Bird with one leg bent and caught in the hand — dancer shape in the air.

skills.name: Dragonfly
skills.base: One foot under the flyer's hip carries the whole load; the free leg balances.
skills.flyer: Cantilevered on a single foot, body long. Hands-free static.

skills.name: Folded Leaf
skills.base: Feet on the flyer's hip creases, toes out. Hands free to massage the flyer's back and shoulders.
skills.flyer: Fold completely, arms and head hang, let go. Gentle spinal traction — nothing to do but breathe.

skills.name: Hangle Dangle
skills.base: Feet on the flyer's hips; hands guide the shoulders as the flyer hangs.
skills.flyer: Inverted hang, torso toward the floor, fully relaxed. Follows Folded Leaf in the forward-flying sequence.

skills.name: Hammock
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's hips as the flyer lies face up; hands support the upper back.
skills.flyer: Drape face-up over the base's feet, restful backbend. Closes the backward-flying sequence.

skills.name: Super Yogi
skills.base: Feet support the flyer's hips and lower back; hands hold the flyer's hands or shoulders.
skills.flyer: Deep supported backbend over the base's feet; legs drape or fold. Several variations.

skills.name: Forward flying sequence
skills.base: Folded Leaf → Hangle Dangle → Straddle Bat → Floating Paschi, with hands massaging throughout.
skills.flyer: Stay heavy and passive; the base does the work.

skills.name: Backward flying sequence
skills.base: Back Bird → High Flying Whale → Hammock, with hip and shoulder adjustments.
skills.flyer: Open the chest, breathe into the backbend.

skills.name: Candlestick
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's shoulders, legs vertical. Hands spot the flyer's hips.
skills.flyer: Shoulderstand on the base's feet with your hands on the base's shins, body straight up like a candle.
skills.note: The most basic shoulderstand-type inversion — start here.

skills.name: Shoulderstand (supported → free)
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's shoulders; hands support the flyer's lower back, then release.
skills.flyer: Vertical inversion on the base's feet, hips over shoulders. Free = no hands anywhere.

skills.name: Star
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's shoulders, hands in hand-to-hand grip, arms straight.
skills.flyer: Inverted, shoulders on the base's feet, hands pressing into the base's hands. Legs straddle or together.

skills.name: Inside Star mount
skills.base: Receive the flyer's shoulders on your feet as they step in between your hands.
skills.flyer: Enter Star from standing inside the base's arms: hands to hands, kick or press up.

skills.name: Free Star
skills.base: Hold Star, then let the hands go; hover them at the flyer's hips.
skills.flyer: Release both hands and balance purely on the shoulders. Arms out or in prayer.

skills.name: Reverse Star
skills.base: Reverse grip; feet under the flyer's shoulders as they face away from you.
skills.flyer: Same shape as Star but facing away — a blind entry. Reverse Free Star drops the hands.

skills.name: Side Star
skills.base: One foot under the flyer's side hip / ribs, one hand under the flyer's shoulder.
skills.flyer: Sideways inversion — leg on the base's foot, hand in the base's hand, top leg free.

skills.name: Tick Tock
skills.base: Rock the flyer from Side Star through Star to the other Side Star; legs and hands swap in rhythm.
skills.flyer: Stay long; let the base move you. Hands change with the feet.

skills.name: Foot to Hand (low → high)
skills.base: Hold the flyer's feet in your hands, arms bent (low) then straight (high). Stack wrists over shoulders.
skills.flyer: Stand in the base's hands, ankles strong, gaze forward. Squeeze legs together.

skills.name: Reverse Foot to Hand
skills.base: Same as F2H, flyer facing away.
skills.flyer: Stand in the base's hands facing their feet.

skills.name: Foot to Foot
skills.base: Flyer stands on your feet; hands connected then released.
skills.flyer: Stand on the base's feet, ankles locked (foot lock), find balance with no hands.
skills.yt_by: 3 ways in and out of F2F

skills.name: Foot to Shins (standing inversion set-ups)
skills.base: Flyer stands on shins; use as the launch pad into Star and F2H.
skills.flyer: From shins, step or press up into the next shape.

skills.name: Hand to Hand (H2H)
skills.base: Receive the flyer's handstand in your hands, arms bent then extended. Wrist strength and grip are everything.
skills.flyer: Full handstand line on the base's hands, no other support. Needs a solid floor handstand first.
skills.note: Extended and one-arm H2H are Expert territory.

skills.name: Bicep Stand
skills.base: Flyer's hands press on your biceps / shoulders; arms bent.
skills.flyer: Handstand on the base's upper arms.

skills.name: Forearm Star / Scorpion Star
skills.base: Feet under the flyer's shoulders as in Star; hands under forearms or free.
skills.flyer: Star on forearms; Scorpion bends the legs over the head.

skills.name: Needle / Lotus Shoulderstand
skills.base: Hold Free Shoulderstand steady through leg changes.
skills.flyer: Free shoulderstand with legs in needle (split) or lotus.

skills.name: Thighstand
skills.base: Chair squat, thighs level; grip the flyer's hands or hips.
skills.flyer: Step onto the base's thighs, stand tall, lean back into the counterbalance.

skills.name: Bird on Shoulders
skills.base: Standing; flyer's hips on your shoulders, hands on their hips.
skills.flyer: Bird shape on a standing base — the standing entry point.

skills.name: Two High (shoulder stand)
skills.base: Flyer stands on your shoulders; hold shins, then release. Spotters mandatory.
skills.flyer: Climb via thigh and stand on the base's shoulders, weight in the heels.
skills.yt_by: How to Stand on Shoulders (2 high)

skills.name: Standing Foot to Hand
skills.base: Standing; flyer stands in your hands at chest or overhead.
skills.flyer: Stand in the hands with a standing base — much less margin than L-base F2H.

skills.name: Flag
skills.base: Hold the flyer horizontally at your side by hip and shoulder / thigh.
skills.flyer: Body rigid and horizontal — the flag flying off the pole.

skills.name: Standing Hand to Hand
skills.base: The classic circus skill: flyer handstand on your hands while you stand.
skills.flyer: Handstand on a standing base.

skills.name: Dance acro lifts & lying-to-standing transitions
skills.base: Move the flyer from the floor / L-base up to standing shapes in flow.
skills.flyer: Ride the momentum; shapes are short and travel.

skills.name: Ninja Star
skills.base: Rotate the flyer Side Star → Star → Side Star → ... around your body; feet and hands swap on each step.
skills.flyer: Stay long and let the shapes change under you.
skills.note: The entry-level washing machine — first machine most people learn.

skills.name: Barrel Roll (low)
skills.base: Roll the flyer sideways across your feet: Bird → side → Back Bird → side → Bird.
skills.flyer: Stay in a straight line; the base rolls you like a log.

skills.name: Nunchuck
skills.base: Swing the flyer pendulum-style from Folded Leaf through Bat and back.
skills.flyer: Hang and swing; this is more ride than work.

skills.name: Four Step (2 · 3 · 4-step)
skills.base: Bird → (Reverse) Star → Back Bird → Throne → Bird. Fewer steps = skip stations.
skills.flyer: The most-taught intermediate machine; every station is a pose you already know.
skills.prereq: Front Bird, Star, Back Bird, Throne

skills.name: Trapdoor
skills.base: Reverse Bird → Back Plank → Foot to Hand → Reverse Bird.
skills.flyer: The 'drop' from Back Plank into F2H is the trapdoor.

skills.name: Tumbleweed
skills.base: Star → Back Plank → Foot to Hand → Star.
skills.flyer: Roll through the inverted stations like a tumbleweed.

skills.name: Spider Roll
skills.base: Star → elevator down to Bat → 'ice-cream scoop' roll to Reverse Throne → straddle sit → back to Star.
skills.flyer: Much loved — the roll from Bat into Reverse Throne is the tricky part.

skills.name: Swimming Mermaid
skills.base: High Flying Whale → bend knees → Mermaid → Bird.
skills.flyer: A swim from backbend to side-lying to Bird.

skills.name: Koala Washing Machine / Eucalyptus Leap
skills.base: Loop built around the Koala pose.
skills.flyer: Fun, simple, popular.

skills.name: Monkey Frog
skills.base: One of the most popular machines; countless variations (Super, Reverse, Conveyor Belt).
skills.flyer: Squat-ride stations — the 'frog' — around the base.

skills.name: Rotisserie / Revolution
skills.base: Rotate the flyer around their long axis through Star positions (2-step has no sacrum station).
skills.flyer: You spin like meat on a spit — hence the name.

skills.name: Catherine's Wheel
skills.base: Flyer wheels around you through Bird → Side → Back Bird → Side. Variations: Maha, Bowcycle, Reverse Back, Foot-to-Foot (advanced).
skills.flyer: The classic cartwheel-in-the-air machine.
skills.prereq: Front Bird, Back Bird, Side Star
skills.note: Taught as a 6-part series: basic, reverse, Maha, pops, whip, pop+whip.

skills.name: Whirly Gig / Carousel · Merry-Go-Round
skills.base: Throne rotations: Straddle Throne → Z-Throne → Reverse Straddle → around.
skills.flyer: You spin seated; hands mostly free.

skills.name: Vertical spin machines (Malom · Back Orbit · Slacker Cycle · Headspin)
skills.base: Continuous vertical rotations with few stopping points.
skills.flyer: Transitions are harder than the poses look.

skills.name: Fully free (hands-free) machines
skills.base: Machines with no hand contact at any station.
skills.flyer: Expert marker per the AcroSpirit level guide.

skills.name: Pops: Bird ↔ Throne, Throne ↔ Star
skills.base: Extend legs sharply to launch the flyer, re-catch in the next shape. Timing over strength.
skills.flyer: Stay tight in the air; the base does the shape change.
skills.prereq: Four Step, solid statics for both shapes
skills.note: Most people start popping around year two. Once the basics click, '50 Acroyoga Pops' (youtu.be/JmImpFX8srE) is the catalogue.

skills.name: Whips & Whops
skills.base: Swing the flyer around one leg to change orientation with momentum.
skills.flyer: Fast orientation change; commit.

skills.name: Icarian: Bed / Log 360
skills.base: Full-release rotational pops — flyer leaves your feet, rotates, lands back.
skills.flyer: A full 360 in the air. Spotters and mats.

skills.name: Varial flip · Martini · Front tuck
skills.base: Multi-axis icarian (Varial = 360 vertical + 180 horizontal).
skills.flyer: Expert markers.

skills.name: Pass the Flyer
skills.base: Two bases hand a flyer between them.
skills.flyer: Stay tight while you change hands.

skills.name: Stacking & pyramids
skills.base: Layered bodies — three-person Back Bird, pyramids.
skills.flyer: Group balance.

skills.name: Podcheska · Banquine · Corbett
skills.base: Group throws and catches from circus acrobatics.
skills.flyer: Expert markers.
